answer: Beacon spot-checks stop bulk fake identities: each agent keeps one anchor identity that a beacon can verify. A newcomer registers its anchor at the inlet and answers a heartbeat per sweep; a comet pass samples anchors, and any anchor missing its heartbeat loses its bond. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 anchors at 20 units each, 20,000 in all, while fakes earn nothing before the next sweep. An honest agent pays 20 once and keeps every reward.
